message: The 404 code 'template.missing' is listed on routes 'deleteTemplate', 'getTemplate', 'publishTemplate', 'updateTemplate', which also answer the derived notFound code, so they have two 404 codes.
fix: Add errorRoles: { notFound: template.missing } on the member node of the collection that lists 'template.missing', or allow seampact/not-found-role on the catalogue entry with a reason.
